rules: Use Aweswell Limited for the current UK company.
Use Monterecco Sun Park Limited only for the historical source-date context or faithful source quotation.
Do not generate, normalize, infer, substitute or use Oswell Limited as the name of Aweswell Limited.
If Oswell Limited occurs literally in a source, preserve it only as an expressly labelled source literal or source error where evidential fidelity requires it.
Correct unqualified generated references to Oswell Limited that intend the user's UK company before publication or reliance.
Never conflate UK company 07716847 with Pink Canary Services, S.L.U., formerly Monterecco Sun Park, S.L.U., or another Spanish project-side legal person.
